newsitem.title: USA: Autotote proposes $100 mln sr note offering.
newsitem.headline: Autotote proposes $100 mln sr note offering.

text.p: Autotote Corp said Thursday it it proposed a private offering of $100 million in seven-year fixed rate senior notes.
Autotote said it will use the proceeds to repay about $93.4 million debt and accrued interest under its existing credit facility.
The company added it intends to replace its existing credit line with a new revolving credit facility for loans of up to $25 million.
Autotote said it expected to complete the transactions before July 30.
The note offering will take place under Rule 144A of the Securities Act of 1933, the company said.
